title: The $1 Million Phone Call
why_movie: RESULT: He gave $250,000 cash to post a friend's bail, never asked for it back, and 20 years later the friend called out of nowhere and paid him a check for $1 million - plus Kevin says his own businesses exploded in profitability right after the day he gave the money. METHOD: he says he was 'planting a seed into the universe' by giving without expecting anything back, not a sales pitch, just the law of giving. WISH: a stranger who hears an unprompted $1 million payback 20 years later would want the 14 audios that teach how giving plants a seed the universe returns.

Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin's 14 free audios on how giving works, the moment you comment.

Kevin Trudeau says a friend's wife once called him frantic - her husband needed $250,000 in cash to post bail on a legal case. Kevin flew down on his own plane that night and paid it himself, never expecting to see a dollar of it again.

Years went by. He never once asked for the money back, and never brought it up again.
